text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Teach! Thanks for giving me a day
off!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yep. You told me to rest, so I did just
that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right. Now it's your turn to blow my

expectations outta the water.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I bet you spent your time off cookin' up
a real
killer of a training regimen for me,
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I knew I could count on ya! All right,
let's get
training, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is raring to go after some
much
needed rest!
